# ZAG Arena listing fixture

`zag_arena_listing.html` keeps four `.wpem-event-layout-wrapper` items from
https://www.zag-arena-hannover.de/veranstaltungen-tickets/ (captured 25 Nov 2026;
the adapter's `/veranstaltungen/` URL now redirects there).

| Item | Origin |
|---|---|
| NIGHT OF THE PROMS | Captured verbatim. |
| PUR | Captured verbatim. |
| KONSTANTINOS ARGIROS – ABGESAGT | PUR's markup with the title, URL and date of the row ZAG listed for 24 Nov 2026 and BoringHannover published as available (#134). The live listing had dropped it by the capture date. |
| TESTKONZERT – VERSCHOBEN | Synthetic: PUR's markup with an invented title, to cover a postponement announced in the title. |

Banner image URLs of the derived items are blanked.
